# MotoFit 2 — Ahmedabad's Premier Motorcycle Engineering & Superbike Workshop

> MotoFit 2 is an independent multi-brand motorcycle workshop, superbike diagnostics hub, and dyno tuning center based in Chandkheda, Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India.

## Core Capabilities & USPs
- **1-Year Engine Guarantee**: Unconditional 1-year warranty on full engine rebuilds and 8 months on half-engine overhauls with micrometer-precise tolerances.
- **Dyno Tuning & ECU Remapping**: Custom air-fuel calibration, torque-curve optimization, and OBD-2 diagnostics for single and multi-cylinder motorcycles.
- **Multi-Brand Superbike Service**: Specialist repair and maintenance for Ducati, Kawasaki, BMW Motorrad, Triumph, Royal Enfield (650 Twins & Himalayan), KTM (Duke & RC), and Japanese litre-class machines.
- **100% Genuine OEM Parts**: Authorized sourcing of Brembo, Motul (300V Synthesis), EBC Brakes, Rolon Brass Chains, and Pirelli tyres.
- **Doorstep Pickup & Drop**: Dedicated hydraulic recovery vehicle servicing Chandkheda, Motera, Sabarmati, New CG Road, Gandhinagar, and Gift City.
